system_description.narrative_title: Escalation and geopoliticization of the Russia–Ukraine war
system_description.narrative_summary: A rapid intensification of the Russia–Ukraine conflict — marked by large-scale Ukrainian drone strikes reaching Moscow and a new Russian air campaign aimed at crushing Ukraine’s economy — is producing broad political, economic and security spillovers. These kinetic escalations interact with contested politics (wartime Russian elections, exile votes), shifting sanctions and asset controls, energy diplomacy (talks of an 'energy truce'), and strengthened Western military and financial support for Ukraine, creating a tightly coupled open system with domestic and international feedbacks.
system_description.scope: Military operations (drone strikes, air campaigns, air defenses), political processes (Russian wartime elections, diplomacy between leaders), economic measures (sanctions, asset seizures, trade and energy deals), alliance responses (NATO and US deployments, arms sales), cyber/info operations, and civilian impacts (casualties, displacement, humanitarian/crime spillovers).
system_description.super_system: The international security and geopolitical order (NATO–Russia–Western relations and their intersection with global energy and economic interdependencies).
adjacent_subsystems: European energy markets and supply chains
Global sanctions, finance and corporate asset networks
NATO and regional military posture (Baltics, Poland, air operations)
Domestic politics in EU/US (sanctions debates, electioneering, diplomacy)

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the overall tempo, scale and kinetic intensity of armed operations (air strikes, drone attacks, artillery, maneuvers) across the conflict environment.

variables.name: Air defense effectiveness
variables.description: Measures the capacity and success rate of air-defense systems and countermeasures to detect and neutralize aerial threats.

variables.name: Infrastructure damage level
variables.description: Measures the cumulative physical destruction to critical economic, transport and energy infrastructure caused by hostilities.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption rate
variables.description: Measures the rate and magnitude of interruptions to energy production, transit and deliveries affecting markets and consumers.

variables.name: Sanctions and restrictions pressure
variables.description: Measures the breadth, intensity and enforcement of external economic and financial restrictive measures applied to actors linked to the conflict.

variables.name: Asset control and seizure extent
variables.description: Measures the share and value of foreign or contested assets that are frozen, seized, placed under control, or otherwise restricted.

variables.name: Defense financial support flow
variables.description: Measures the rate of incoming financial assistance and budgetary transfers earmarked for defence, security and reconstruction related to the conflict.

variables.name: Arms transfer volume
variables.description: Measures the volume and frequency of transfers of weapons, munitions and military equipment into and around the conflict theatre.

variables.name: Cyber attack activity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, sophistication and impact of offensive cyber operations targeting infrastructure, communications and political systems.

variables.name: Information polarization level
variables.description: Measures the degree of societal and media polarization, misinformation intensity, and competing narratives about the conflict.

variables.name: Electoral legitimacy perception
variables.description: Measures public and external confidence in the fairness, representativeness and legitimacy of political processes occurring during the conflict.

variables.name: Displaced population stock
variables.description: Measures the cumulative number of civilians displaced internally or across borders as a result of hostilities and insecurity.

variables.name: Humanitarian needs severity
variables.description: Measures the scale and severity of acute humanitarian needs including casualties, medical care requirements, food insecurity and shelter shortages.

variables.name: Economic interdependence strain
variables.description: Measures the degree to which cross-border trade, investment, financial ties and energy interdependencies are disrupted, politicized or rerouted.

variables.name: Transnational crime flow
variables.description: Measures the rate and scale of cross-border criminal activity and illicit economic flows (fraud, smuggling, exploitation) amplified by the conflict environment.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion
variables.description: Measures the degree of coordination, unity of purpose and policy alignment among external security and political partners responding to the conflict.

catalysts.title: Zelenskiy–Trump UN meeting
catalysts.description: Scheduled high-level meeting to push an energy truce and discuss ceasefire/energy arrangements, potentially altering diplomatic support and energy flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Zelenskiy to meet Trump at UN in push for energy truce"; "Zelenskiy says he and Trump agree to meet in New York".

catalysts.title: Delivery of US air‑defense upgrades
catalysts.description: Rollout and deliveries after US clears a $2.7bn sale of air‑defense development upgrades, strengthening Ukrainian air defenses over coming months.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "US clears way for $2.7 billion sale to Ukraine of air-defense development upgrades."

catalysts.title: Reciprocal large‑scale drone campaign
catalysts.description: Sustained, high‑tempo drone strikes (including jet‑powered systems) by both sides targeting cities, refineries and infrastructure, continuing kinetic escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Ukraine hits Moscow with ‘largest ever’ drone attack"; "Russia’s new air campaign seeks to destroy Ukrainian economy"; "Jet-powered Russian drones strain Ukraine's air defences."

catalysts.title: Continued seizure of Western firm operations in Russia
catalysts.description: Russia placing foreign subsidiaries under external administration and seizing operations (e.g., Nestlé, Auchan, AptarGroup), likely to continue or expand.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Russia seizes control of Nestlé and Auchan operations"; "AptarGroup Russian subsidiary placed under temporary external administration."

catalysts.title: EU talks to delist Russian‑linked oligarchs
catalysts.description: Negotiations and political moves to lift or narrow sanctions on oligarchs (Usmanov, Fridman) that could erode sanctions scope and unity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "EU to lift sanctions on two Russian oligarchs"; "How France and Luxembourg fatally wounded the EU’s Russia sanctions regime."

catalysts.title: Implementation of new U.S. sanctions and tariff powers
catalysts.description: Rollout and enforcement of U.S. law expanding sanctions/tariff tools targeting importers of Russian energy and firms, affecting trade and energy links.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law"; "House Passes Bill Aimed at Punishing Top Importers of Russian Oil and Gas."

catalysts.title: Baltic and regional critical‑infrastructure hardening
catalysts.description: Plans to fortify substations and energy infrastructure (e.g., Lithuania) and expand protective measures against drone/terror threats.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Lithuania plans key substation near Russia, fortified against explosive drones"; "In the Baltics, NATO Forces Are Trying to Learn the New Way of War."

catalysts.title: Expanded U.S. intelligence coordination role
catalysts.description: U.S. intelligence leadership taking a greater role in talks and operational coordination, likely increasing information-sharing and targeted support.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "US spy chief prepares for greater role in Russia-Ukraine talks"; "Zelenskiy and US spy chief Ratcliffe meet in Ireland."

catalysts.title: Poland's military aviation operations near border
catalysts.description: Poland initiating/continuing military aviation operations near Russia amid strikes, altering regional operational tempo and posture.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Poland starts military aviation operations amid Russian strikes on Ukraine"; "Poland concludes military air operations, says no airspace violation."
